quote: The first step: don't be anxious. Nature controls it all. And before long you'll be no one, nowhere — just like Hadrian, just like Augustus. The second step: fix your gaze on the thing itself, and remember that your duty is to be a good human being. Do it without hesitation, and say exactly what seems most just to you — but gently, modestly, without hypocrisy.
author: Marcus Aurelius
reflection: Pick one conversation today where you say the honest thing instead of the comfortable thing, and say it quietly rather than forcefully.
